family.title: Three tools for the same desktop
family.body: PowerBGInfo shows what a machine is and how it is doing. InformationBox lets the person at the desk act on it. DesktopManager controls the desktop itself. Use one, or let them work together.

products.title: PowerBGInfo
products.summary: Facts and health drawn onto the wallpaper and lock screen. Everyone at the machine sees them without clicking anything, and you deploy it to whole fleets.
products.runs: Windows; macOS and Linux in preview

products.title: InformationBox
products.summary: A self-service window for the person at the desk. Check status, copy an IP address, open a ticket or run an approved fix without calling the helpdesk.
products.for: End users and the helpdesk behind them

products.title: DesktopManager
products.summary: Monitors, windows, wallpaper, audio, power, devices and input. Use the app with hotkeys and rules, or automate it from PowerShell, C#, a CLI or an AI agent.
products.for: Power users, admins, automation, AI agents
products.ships: App, 133 cmdlets, NuGet package, CLI, MCP server
products.runs: Windows; display and wallpaper API on macOS and Linux
